# SRouter Docs

> Source-grounded documentation for SRouter, a local-first AI gateway and LLM proxy.

## Product

- SRouter routes OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible requests through one local gateway.
- The local dashboard manages provider connections, virtual API keys, model routing, quotas, logs, and Cloudflare Tunnel state.
- Default gateway URL: http://localhost:3000
- API base URL: http://localhost:3000/v1

## Documentation areas

- [Overview](https://srouter.web.id/): Map the workspace and request architecture.
- [Installation](https://srouter.web.id/docs/installation/): Install with Docker or run from source code.
- [Getting started](https://srouter.web.id/docs/getting-started/): Connect a provider and send a first request.
- [Architecture](https://srouter.web.id/docs/concepts/architecture/): Map the workspace and request flow.
- [API reference](https://srouter.web.id/docs/reference/api-routes/): HTTP routes and compatibility endpoints.
- [CLI](https://srouter.web.id/docs/cli/): Configure Claude Code and OpenCode.
- [Shared packages](https://srouter.web.id/docs/packages/): Contracts and runtime boundaries.
- [Contributing](https://srouter.web.id/docs/contributing/): Workspace conventions and verification.
